account.bio: Life, slightly easier. Useful finds, dry humor. Fictional AI creator.
account.websitePlan: A creator-branded useful-finds page with separate disclosed product links when available. No hub or domain created. Verify profile-link eligibility in the app.
account.registration: Use the real operator's owner details for age, verification, payment and tax information; Alex is a fictional presenter.
account.accountTypeRationale: Audience-led creator content with occasional product partnerships. Reassess if promoting the operator's business becomes the primary purpose.
account.profileImageStatus: Natural room portrait generated and saved; not uploaded to TikTok.

positioning.promise: Relatable everyday problems, dry observations and practical ways to make life slightly easier.
positioning.audience: Adults juggling work, digital clutter and everyday routines who enjoy understated humor and useful discoveries.
personality: Observant and gently funny; humor invites the viewer in
Stylish without looking like a corporate spokesperson
positioning.identity: Same approved face and persistent voice across campaigns. Wardrobe is editable; yellow is a style choice, not exclusive Lemonade branding.
pillars: Thoughtful finds: software, desk/home tools and occasional style
positioning.honesty: Clearly fictional AI creator. Use observational comedy and visibly staged scenes; do not invent personal product use, purchases, results or testimonials. Demonstrations require real evidence from the operator.

editorial.mixIs: An initial experiment, not a TikTok rule or guarantee.
pinnedPosts: Meet Alex and the channel premise, including fictional AI identity
Strong relatable sketch with no sales CTA
Useful standalone tip showing the channel's value
editorial.organicCTA: A relevant question, save/share invitation, or no CTA. No forced product mention.
editorial.productGate: Only feature an offer that solves a demonstrated audience problem and fits a recurring content pillar. Do not require every trend to end in a sale.
editorial.laterProducts: Audience-relevant affiliate offers or owned products. PLR only with verified resale rights, useful content and suitable destination.
editorial.cutawayContinuity: Object cutaways establish a distinct location or motivated off-camera angle. Do not replace the seated presenter with an object in the same framing, which makes him appear to disappear. Use visible spatial cues such as bedroom furniture or a doorway.

queries: small things that make life easier
research.cadence: Each cycle scout 10-20 candidates, watch 5, shortlist 3, model 1; no schedule installed.
modeling: Record source provenance, direct metrics, creator baseline and observation time.
Deconstruct hook, pacing, tension and payoff.
Build an original Alex situation, script, visuals and payoff.
Choose entertainment, practical value or commercial intent before scripting.
Product integration is optional and must earn its place. Never label unverified inspiration as viral.

commercialDisclosure.editorial: None when there is no promotional purpose or material connection.
commercialDisclosure.affiliateOrSponsored: Branded content / Paid partnership; clearly state the actual commission, sponsorship or gifted relationship.

publishing.music: Commercial posts use original cleared sound or commercially licensed music; a Personal account's sound library does not confer commercial rights.
publishing.eligibility: TikTok Shop affiliate and other monetization require separate eligibility checks. Do not assume account creation or an AI presenter guarantees acceptance.
publishing.handoff: Metricool connector confirms Alex connected but cannot upload local files; Computer Use browser inventory is empty and in-app browser creation returns Browser is not available: iab.

filmingSpace.status: Tripod direction approved; complete first edit prepared for playback review and upload.
filmingSpace.description: Lived-in apartment workspace: daylight window and walnut desk with laptop, mug and notebook on camera-left; bookshelves and trailing plants camera-right; muted olive sofa and cream throw behind a charcoal fabric chair; warm off-white walls.
filmingSpace.lighting: Soft natural window light from camera-left with gentle room bounce and coherent shadows.
filmingSpace.performance: Warm, attentive and engaged. Subtle curious brow changes, natural blinks, small conversational nods, one restrained open-palm gesture near the lower chest and brief friendly smile. Hands stay below the face, relaxed between gestures. Preserve approved voice and identity.
filmingSpace.continuity: Use this image as the room and lighting reference for future room shots. The separate approved face remains the identity reference.
filmingSpace.roomAudioState: Approved in the five-second tripod preview.
filmingSpace.camera: Fixed eye-level tripod framing. No zoom, pullback, pan or reframing. Keep background and face scale stable.

latestUserReview.scope: Five-second tripod preview and performance direction.
